procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). Admission by reading: D, a claim on AttributionBench, named; R, a relation the archive states between it and an archive object; O, an archive category applied to it or to the class the field sources for it (automatic attribution evaluation: B1, B3; the census's kind and relation_types). A bare mention, a list entry or a reference line is not a claim. The string pass returned no D and no R candidate: no archive text names AttributionBench, its arXiv number, its dataset id or its title (and none names AttriBench). Beyond the string pass, every archive text naming the class's measures in the field's or the archive's words (RAG faithfulness, citation precision/recall/quality, ALCE, AIS, attribution evaluation, attribution scores) was read at the passage (grep over data/texts), since the pass cuts sentences at 900 characters and misses phrases broken by Markdown emphasis.
first_run: A first run with bare 'attributable' in the class pattern returned 66 O-class candidates in 41 deposits; read, all were generic uses of the word (attributable authorship, value attributable to Mary Lee, attributable sources of an entity) and none applies a category to attribution evaluation; the pattern was narrowed and the run repeated (the files in this folder are the second configuration's).
